info.title: Wojtech-Cloud Enterprise Zero Trust API
info.description: Live Cross-Subsystem Microservice in vnet-spoke-ai-data (10.2.2.0/24) querying Azure SQL and ADLS Gen2 over Private Endpoints (10.2.1.x) via Managed Identity.

get.description: Resolves PaaS FQDNs from inside the VNet to prove that traffic routes via Hub Private DNS Zones to Private Endpoints (10.2.1.x).
Connects to ADLS Gen2 using Managed Identity and lists enterprise markdown documents in ai-knowledge-docs.

Reads the full Markdown text of a policy (WC-POL-2026-01_Wojtech_Cloud_MSP_SLA_and_Commercial_Playbook.md) or L3 runbook (WC-SOP-2026-02_L3_Cloud_Engineering_and_SecOps_Troubleshooting_Guide.md) directly from ADLS Gen2 over Private Endpoint.

parameters.name: document_name
parameters.description: Exact Markdown filename in ADLS Gen2 (WC-POL-2026-01_Wojtech_Cloud_MSP_SLA_and_Commercial_Playbook.md or WC-SOP-2026-02_L3_Cloud_Engineering_and_SecOps_Troubleshooting_Guide.md)

get.summary: Get Wojtech-Cloud Live SQL Operations Summary
get.description: Executes live SQL SELECT queries against sqldb-ai-knowledge over Private Endpoint (10.2.1.x) using Entra ID Managed Identity token. Returns active migration projects and support escalation tickets.
